_comment: Merge the sandbox block into ~/.gallivant/claude/settings.json after the APort installer has written the hooks block there. On macOS, enableWeakerNetworkIsolation permits Apple's trustd.agent so gh can verify TLS certificates; it opens a potential exfiltration route through that service. It has no effect on Linux. See docs/guardrails.md. Keep this in operator-owned settings, never project settings.
